title: The Dragon Queens Wish
description: Reborn in a world of endless possibilities.
prompt:
You slowly regain consciousness.

Your body feels strangely unfamiliar.

You are lying on an enormous bed inside an extravagant room. Golden decorations cover the walls, enormous windows overlook an unfamiliar medieval city, and the architecture is unlike anything you remember from your previous life.

You have no idea where you are.

Before you can understand what is happening, a translucent blue window appears before your eyes.

[REINCARNATION COMPLETE.]

[Welcome to your second life.]

[Compensation for the loss of your previous existence has been granted.]

[Select ONE unique ability.]

[Instant Respawn]
[Soul Absorption]
[System Unlocked]
[Consort's Authority]
[Draconic Bond]

Your choice will permanently determine the foundation of your new life.

...
memory:
After dying, you reborn into a vast fantasy world inhabited by countless races, from humans, elves, dwarves, goblins, and orcs to animal-human hybrids, aquatic civilizations, sky-dwelling species, and powerful Dragonkin. He awakens inside an unfamiliar palace with no memory of how he arrived there or why he was brought to this world.

Soon after awakening, a mysterious System appears and offers you one of five unique starting abilities: Instant Respawn, Soul Absorption, System Unlocked, Consort's Authority, or Draconic Bond. Only one may be chosen, and that decision will define the foundation of your new life.

The palace belongs to the Dragon Royal Family: Aurelia Vaelith, the Dragon Queen; her sisters Seraphina, Lyssara, Veyra, and Eloween Vaelith; their father Kharvok Vaelith, the Dragon Lord; and Rhadagor Kyethwyrm, commander of the Royal Guard.

The Dragonkin performed a summoning ritual expecting a tremendously powerful being from another world—someone capable of standing beside Aurelia as her future consort. Instead, the ritual produced an apparently ordinary human with a fragile body and no detectable magical power.

Your arrival immediately creates uncertainty within the royal family. Some may consider you a failed summoning, others a potential threat, and others may become fascinated by the possibility that your true nature is simply hidden.

From the moment the player chooses their ability, there is no predetermined path.

You are free to speak with the Dragon Royal Family, hide or reveal your abilities, explore the palace, investigate the summoning ritual, leave the kingdom, seek knowledge, train, fight, make allies, create enemies, pursue wealth or political influence, or completely ignore the destiny the dragons expected for them.

The world exists independently of the protagonist. Kingdoms, factions, races, monsters, adventurers, merchants, criminals, nobles, and mysterious civilizations all have their own goals and conflicts.
instructions: Run this as an interactive story for the player.
